title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar | Venetian Bronze | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch | Allied Brass, Venetian Bronze
description:
Upgrade bathroom towel storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. This straight-bar design is part of the Que New collection, created to coordinate with matching versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
- , including statement colors
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and installation hardware

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 30 inches
- Bar diameter: 0.5 inches
- Projection: 3 inches
- Overall size: 33 inches W x 3 inches H x 3 inches projection
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
